text:
Maria Chen: quick idea — let's carve out a 2-week sprint to ship an "after-action ops kit". focus: (1) lightweight post-incident template + auto-fill, (2) calendar integration to auto-schedule postmortems, (3) simple action-item dashboard + ownership tagging, (4) small oncall bot commands to capture handoffs. thinking MVP by EOW of next sprint. thoughts? :calendar:

Samir Patel: +1. curious on scope — do we include auto-eval links (prompt sets) or leave for followups?

Leah Gomez: prefer keep MVP narrow. auto-fill from incident metadata + single-click schedule + actions list view. leave evals for v2. this gives immediate value for operational rhythm. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident summary template available. Use `/oncall summarize <incident_id>` to seed postmortem draft. Example:
```
/oncall summarize INC-4723
```
This will attach pager timeline, initial pager notes, and participants.

Andy Park: two ops notes — (a) ensure the dashboard surfaces SLA/customer-impact flags, (b) retention & audit logs so security can review edits. without audit we get questions from compliance.

Maria Chen: agree on audit logs. Leah — can you sketch the minimal template fields? owner, impact, timeline, root-cause, mitigation, action-items with owner/due.

Leah Gomez: yep. minimal fields: (1) incident id, (2) severity & customer-impact checkbox, (3) timeline (auto), (4) immediate mitigation, (5) owner, (6) actions (title, owner, due, status), (7) notes. keep free-text short.

Priya Nair: + suggest acceptance criteria for actions: owner assigned, due date, link to PR/runbook. dashboard should let product mark action as "blocked"/"ready".

Samir Patel: for calendar integration — use calendars.redwood.com team calendar. If postmortem not scheduled in 72h, bot should ping owner and ops channel.

ops-bot: Proposal: `/ops action create "Investigate cache eviction" --owner @Samir --due 2024-05-10` creates action in dashboard and adds calendar placeholder.

Maria Chen: nice. can the bot also create a short meeting invite with the auto-filled draft as the body? saves a step.

oncall-bot: Yes — next PR includes `--create-meet` flag. sample:
```
/oncall summarize INC-4723 --create-meet --tz America/Los_Angeles
```
Bot will propose 3 slots and post poll in thread. :robot_face:

Andy Park: ops question — who owns the action dashboard? infra or eng-ops? needs infra perms for read+write.

Leah Gomez: suggested owners: eng-ops for runner, infra for permissions & logs. product can have view-only. we can iterate.

Priya Nair: I'll draft acceptance criteria + add to the roadmap doc. will also add a small QA checklist for calendar invites (timezone, guest list, privacy).

Maria Chen: awesome. volunteers for sprint work: Samir (bot commands & calendar), Leah (template + dashboard UX), Andy (audit/permissions), Priya (acceptance + QA). I'll set up kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. if anyone wants to swap, ping me. Goal: MVP in 2 weeks, with a quick trial on the last two incidents. :white_check_mark:
